verdict.rationale: Temporal provides official multi-language SDKs with documented APIs for Workflow/Activity execution, a documented CLI (temporal server start-dev, operator/workflow commands), and a Client API bridging apps to the service, enabling developers to build custom integrations and connectors. Community evidence corroborates real-world SDK/CLI usage and even responsive support for library bugs. Missing for 10: a public REST/OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s) and independent evidence of third-party custom connectors built on the SDK beyond first-party docs.
